services.name: Learn To Skydive
services.desc: The top-notch instructors at ASC are here to teach you how to enjoy a long and safe career in skydiving. Our program uses an innovative set of online learning tools in conjunction with a tandem progression and accelerated free fall (AFF) training. Our online tool set allows you to participate in the class work from the comfort of your home and do more jumping while you are at the DZ. By moving the class work to the cloud our instructors are freed up to focus our student time developing muscle memory through proper body kinetics. Freefall - how to fly a belly to earth body position and execute flight with other jumpers in the

explain.meaning: You jump strapped to an instructor who handles the parachute.

blurb: Alaska Skydive Center offers tandem skydiving for beginners, training programs for those who want to learn to skydive, and drop-zone services for licensed skydivers. Located at Palmer Municipal Airport, the center provides scenic jumps in the Matanuska Valley. They also offer gift certificates for skydiving experiences.
